353:t_1:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Hey. It looks like you've calmed down.」

353:t_1:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just call me $$クロウ$$. Whatever you do, don't call me $$揺れる天秤$$.」

353:t_1:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'd rather be called a debtor or a magnet for bad luck than that.」

353:t_1:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Ah... Well, forget it for now.」

353:t_1:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You'll find out soon enough... whether you want to or not.」

353:t_1:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I thought you looked sensitive, but you've got a hell of a smile.」

353:t_1:13.en:
$n
「$$ランド$$ taught me how to smile.」

353:t_1:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And your piloting's in $$セツコ$$'s $$グローリー・スター$$ style, huh?」

353:t_1:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I took a little look at your data. Believe it or not, I've made my living piloting machines.」

353:t_1:17.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What are you talking about?! You could barely eat with those debt payments!」

353:t_1:18.en:
$$青山$$
「Lay off, $$デュオ$$. Sugar water's an important meal for $$クロウ$$, too.」

353:t_1:20.en:
$n
「Um... You've been through a lot, haven't you? Mostly financially...」

353:t_1:21.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks for being considerate. ...Not as thanks, but as a fellow Reactor with more experience, I ought to give you something...」

353:t_1:22.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$n! If you're asking for something, make it anything but money!」

353:t_1:23.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Even if you did ask, you couldn't shake a single G out of $$クロウ$$ by holding him upside down.」

353:t_1:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... It's fine. I'll give you something other than money. ...Words I was taught when I joined the military.」

353:t_1:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Frustration makes a man. Misery makes a man. Sorrow makes a man...」

353:t_1:29.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And a mighty enemy is what truly makes you a great man... ...Those are the words of an ace from an old war.」

353:t_1:30.en:
$n
「You're the second person who's told me those words.」

353:t_1:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I blew it... I tried to give a kid some words of wisdom, and someone beat me to it...」

353:t_1:32.en:
$n
「No... Thank you. Thanks to you... I've found the strength to keep living again.」

353:t_1:33.en:
$$クロウ$$
「By the way, who was the first?」

353:t_1:34.en:
$n
「It was my dad. He taught me survival skills, $$ジークンドー$$, and the strength to live.」

353:t_1:35.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$ジークンドー$$, huh... So that's the basis for how your machine moves.」

353:t_1:36.en:
$$クロウ$$
「All right... Once things settle down, let's spar. You'll face my $$システマ$$.」

353:t_1:37.en:
$n
「Dad said the $$人革連$$'s health exercises could never beat $$ジークンドー$$, a martial art for the whole person.」

353:t_1:38.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Interesting... Maybe I'll knock a cocky kid down a peg.」

353:t_1:39.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What are you two doing, $n, $$クロウ$$?! Everyone's already in the briefing room!」

353:t_1:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly... You're getting over being the quiet type, but you still need to know how to work with a group.」

353:t_1:42.en:
$n
「Understood. ...$$クロウ$$... I'm looking forward to our match.」

353:t_1:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. Let's get the briefing over with first.」

353:t_1:44.en:
$$クロウ$$
(It looks like we're both weak for older beauties with glasses, $n...)

353:t_1:45.en:
$$クロウ$$
(But $$ジークンドー$$, huh... Your dad wanted to train your mind even more than your body...)

353:t_1:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I'll be expecting great things from you. $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ entrusted his hopes to you.)

353:t_1:51.en:
$$万丈$$
「...First, let me say how glad I am that you've returned to the solar system.」

353:t_1:52.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Sorry, $$万丈$$. We had to ask you to arrange our trip from Mars to the Earth Sphere.」

353:t_1:53.en:
$$万丈$$
「Please, don't worry about it. First, you need to know the situation on $$蒼の地球$$.」

353:t_1:54.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「About a month and a half has passed since we were caught in the $$時空震動$$... What happened in that time?」

353:t_1:55.en:
$$万丈$$
「With $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s help and $$アマルガム$$'s covert schemes, the $$新地球皇国$$ retains an overwhelming lead over the $$地球連邦$$.」

353:t_1:56.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「Now, allow me to show you a map of the Empire's current holdings.」

353:t_1:57.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「Forgive my late introduction. I am $$ギャリソン時田$$, $$破嵐万丈$$'s butler.」

353:t_1:59.en:
$$シャア$$
「The Empire controls 83.3%... I was prepared for bad news, but not this much.」

353:t_1:60.en:
$$アマタ$$
「They've taken over almost the entire Earth!」

353:t_1:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「It seems only the area around Japan and the $$新世界大陸$$ can still put up a real fight.」

353:t_1:62.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even North America, where the $$地球連邦$$'s main forces remained, is almost completely occupied...」

353:t_1:63.en:
$$ガロード$$
「At this rate, Earth might not hold out until we get back!」

353:t_1:64.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
(The Colonel... no, the Brigadier General is safe, right...?)

353:t_1:65.en:
$$カレン$$
($$ポタリア$$, $$キデーラ$$... Did they get you, too...?)

353:t_1:66.en:
$$万丈$$
「Of course, guerrilla resistance continues even in areas under the Empire's control.」

353:t_1:67.en:
$$万丈$$
「Their rule depends on $$ターミナル・ベース$$s and connecting $$レイライン$$s. Taking those could turn everything around at once.」

353:t_1:70.en:
$$勝平$$
「All of $c's back together, and we've got new friends, too!」

353:t_1:71.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Once we get back to Earth, our counterattack begins!」

353:t_1:72.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...But we can't beat them without a plan.」

353:t_1:73.en:
$$レド$$
「Agreed. We mustn't forget our defeat at $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

353:t_1:74.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We bet on breaking through then, but their strength exceeded even $$ゼロ$$ and $$スメラギ$$'s estimates.」

353:t_1:75.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Without the Colonel and $$葵$$'s team's support, we would've been finished there.」

353:t_1:76.en:
$$赤木$$
「But we've already gathered all the forces we can. We can't do any more than this.」

353:t_1:77.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we must find a way to win with the forces we have.」

353:t_1:79.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll find one... And if there isn't one, I'll make one.」

353:t_1:80.en:
$$ノノ$$
「S-so cool...! That's a real hero of justice!」

353:t_1:81.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't know... He sounds desperate to me.」

353:t_1:82.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「No, $$ラルク$$. You never give up, and you strive for victory to the very end... That's hard work and guts.」

353:t_1:84.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...I can't put up with this.」
